name: TOB Content Translation
description: One translated field value for one document, one row per (source_doctype, source_name, field, language) — the generic 'translate any content into any supported language' store, so a new content type (memory verses today, lessons/community/notifications later) never needs its own translation doctype. Mirrors TOB Bible Topic Translation's translation_status workflow (Draft/Machine Translated/.../Published) but generalized: source_doctype/source_name/field stand in for that doctype's single hardcoded `topic` Link, since this table has to span many source doctypes, including ones (like Frappe LMS's own `LMS Quiz Question`) this app doesn't own and must never write back to directly.

fields.label: Source Doctype
fields.description: Plain doctype name, not a Link — spans doctypes this app doesn't own (e.g. Frappe LMS's own LMS Quiz Question), so a Link/options constraint would be wrong here.

fields.label: Field
fields.description: The source document's own fieldname being translated, e.g. 'title' or 'simple_meaning'.

fields.label: Translation Status
fields.options:
Draft
Machine Translated
Human Reviewed
Approved
Published
Needs Revision
fields.description: Only Published rows are ever served to students — everything earlier is a review-in-progress state, same discipline as TOB Bible Topic Translation.

fields.label: Source Text Hash
fields.description: Hash of the source field's text at translation time. If the source is edited afterward, this no longer matches — the admin bulk-translate screen uses that mismatch to flag a translation as stale without needing a separate 'last synced' timestamp.

fields.label: Translated By
fields.description: 'AI' for a machine translation, or the admin's user id for a manual edit.
